sb_rift_warden: Brakka Stonehoof, warden of the Rift. That canyon just south of the Waystation cuts the Southern Barrens in two. Everything beyond it is the Rift's business; everything this side is mine. Try to keep them separate.
sb_bonehunter: Rurk Gravetusk. Bonehunter. Giants walked this plain once - the Field of Giants, all round you. Now it's bones, hyenas and me. I'm the only one who likes the company.
sb_thornwatch: Oggra, Thornwatch. Blackthorn Ridge is north-west of my fire and the Razorfen approach is south of it - quilboar both ways, and one very annoyed ranger in the middle. Don't stand near my fire.
sb_keep_spy: Zhuul Quicksight. Dat be Bael'dun Keep up da hill to da west - dwarves, Alliance, guns. Keep your voice low, mon. Dey got good ears and bad tempers.
sb_modan_scout: Tarrik Ashmane, dig-scout. The dwarves' excavation at Bael Modan is just west of here. The quarry's loud, they're louder, and the pit keeps getting deeper. I don't like what they're digging toward.
sb_hoodoo_huntress: Alamir Bloodtotem. I hunt the Hoodoo Spires, east of this camp, and the Raptor Grounds south of them. Stay low in the spires. The wind carries voices out there, and some of them are not the wind's.
sb_crater_digger: Fizzwick Boltcog, licensed excavator! Okay, not licensed. Okay, not an excavator. But that sinkhole east of my tent goes down a long way, and something at the bottom is digging back.
sb_innkeeper: Doda Longhorn. This is the Waystation - the last inn before the Rift. The cots are narrow and the soup is mostly soup. Make it your hearth?
sb_flight_master: Orga, windrider master at the Waystation. The canyon's too wide to walk and too wide to jump. Fly with me - anywhere you've already been.
ct_sbarrens: Sunwalker. I train every discipline at the Waystation. You'll want what I teach before you cross the Rift, not after.
pt_sbarrens_forge: Kaga. Mining and smithing. The Rift lays the ore bare if you know which wall to look at. I'll show you, and what to do with it.
pt_sbarrens_herbs: Greyhoof, apothecary. Herbalism and alchemy. Things grow along the Rift's edge that grow nowhere else in the Barrens.
pt_sbarrens_wood: Bloodhoof - a distant branch. Woodcutting and woodworking. Timber's scarce until the aspen country south of here; learn to cut it properly before you get there.
pt_sbarrens_hide: Moonfeather. Skinning, leatherworking, tailoring and cooking. The Field of Giants is the best hunting south of the Crossroads - bring me what you take.
pt_sbarrens_essence: Nara. I teach engineering. The dwarves at Bael Modan leave good parts lying about, if you're willing to go and ask them loudly.
